about: Water names in Iowa's records that data/receiving-waters-national.json does not hold for IA: the receiving streams the Department of Natural Resources' field offices entered on the incoming reports read for the major municipal facilities, and the waters the Department's news releases name; Waterloo's notices name no water. One row per name and county (the county the record gives), with the number of reports, how many are open now, and the operators; the reports give no point. Records naming no water are left out (by_reason). Written by scripts/ia_id_report_water_names.py.
